source.title: Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Rural Council election results in Co. Derry"); Irish News, 3 June 1955, p. 1 ("Derry Rural Council: Banagher")
source.publisher: Derry Journal (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: DYJ 3 Jun 1955 p1: 'John Conway ... 141; James Peter O'Kane ... 100; the poll was 243' (OCR garbled around the heading); INW 3 Jun 1955 p1 'John Conway ... defeated James P. O'Kane ... by 141 to 100'.

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. One contest, Banagher (Derry Journal, 3 June 1955, p. 1). The other twelve divisions added from the Returning Officer's notice of the result (Derry Journal, 6 June 1955, p. 5) (round-2 gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026). The report notes the poll was 243 with two spoiled votes.
